<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>

<style>
:root {
  --af-navy: #eef3f7;
  --af-card: #FFFFFF;
  --af-bright: #0049ff;
  --af-cyan: #0DD8F9;
  --af-orange: #FFAD44;
  --af-chip: #D6E8FF;
  --af-tagline: rgba(13, 13, 82, 0.55);
  --af-welcome: #0d0d52;
  --af-on: #0d0d52;
  --af-muted: rgba(13, 13, 82, 0.72);
  --af-soft: rgba(13, 13, 82, 0.48);
  --af-hairline: rgba(13, 13, 82, 0.12);
  --af-card-on: #0d0d52;
  --af-card-muted: rgba(13, 13, 82, 0.68);
  --af-card-soft: rgba(13, 13, 82, 0.48);
  --af-card-hairline: rgba(13, 13, 82, 0.10);
}

html, body {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  min-height: 100%;
  font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;
  background-color: var(--af-navy) !important;
  color: var(--af-on);
}

#header,
h1.title,
.title,
.book-header,
.book-summary {
  display: none !important;
}

.book .book-body,
.book .page-inner,
.book .page-wrapper,
.book .section.normal {
  background-color: var(--af-navy) !important;
  border: none !important;
  max-width: none !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
}

.book-body {
  margin-left: 0 !important;
}

#mics-landing {
  min-height: 100vh;
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  background: var(--af-navy);
}

.af-nav {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  padding: 12px 20px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--af-hairline);
  background: var(--af-navy);
}

.af-nav-brand {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: var(--af-on);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 17px;
}

.af-nav-brand img {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  object-fit: contain;
  display: block;
}

.af-nav-spacer {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 8px;
}

.af-search-wrap {
  position: relative;
  min-width: 200px;
  max-width: 280px;
  flex: 1;
}

.af-search {
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  border: 1px solid var(--af-hairline);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  padding-right: 64px;
  background: #FFFFFF;
  color: var(--af-on);
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 15px;
  outline: none;
}

.af-search::placeholder {
  color: var(--af-soft);
}

.af-search:focus {
  border-color: var(--af-bright);
}

.af-search-kbd {
  position: absolute;
  right: 10px;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--af-soft);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.af-search-results {
  display: none;
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  top: calc(100% + 6px);
  z-index: 40;
  background: var(--af-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--af-card-hairline);
  border-radius: 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
  max-height: 320px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(13, 13, 82, 0.10);
}

.af-search-results.open {
  display: block;
}

.af-search-hit {
  display: block;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: var(--af-card-on);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--af-card-hairline);
}

.af-search-hit:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}

.af-search-hit:hover,
.af-search-hit.active {
  background: rgba(13, 13, 82, 0.05);
}

.af-search-hit-title {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.af-search-hit-meta {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--af-card-soft);
  margin-top: 2px;
}

.af-search-empty {
  padding: 12px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--af-card-soft);
}

.af-nav-link {
  color: var(--af-bright);
  font-weight: 500;
  font-size: 16px;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.af-nav-link-muted {
  color: var(--af-muted);
  font-size: 15px;
  text-decoration: none;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
}

.af-nav-link-muted:hover {
  color: var(--af-on);
}

.af-nav-github {
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  display: block;
  fill: currentColor;
}

.af-hero {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.15fr 0.85fr;
  gap: 24px;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 28px 28px 12px;
}

@media (max-width: 800px) {
  .af-hero {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    padding: 20px 16px 8px;
  }
  .af-hero-logo {
    order: -1;
    justify-content: flex-start;
  }
}

.af-hero-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: clamp(26px, 3.2vw, 36px);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.2;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: var(--af-bright);
}

.af-hero-sub {
  margin: 10px 0 0;
  font-size: clamp(15px, 1.8vw, 20px);
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.35;
  color: var(--af-on);
}

.af-hero-tag {
  margin: 6px 0 0;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  color: var(--af-tagline);
}

.af-hero-logo {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 0;
}

.af-hero-logo img {
  width: min(280px, 70vw);
  height: auto;
  display: block;
  object-fit: contain;
}

.af-features {
  padding: 12px 28px 40px;
}

.af-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 16px;
}

@media (max-width: 960px) {
  .af-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .af-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .af-features {
    padding: 20px 16px 40px;
  }
}

.af-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 22px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--af-card-hairline);
  background: var(--af-card);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(13, 13, 82, 0.07);
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
  height: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}

.af-card:hover {
  border-color: rgba(0, 73, 255, 0.35);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 22px rgba(13, 13, 82, 0.11);
}

.af-card-icon {
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  object-fit: contain;
  display: block;
}

.af-card-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--af-card-on);
}

.af-card-chip {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-self: flex-start;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 4px 12px;
  border: none;
  background: var(--af-chip);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--af-on);
}

.af-card-details {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--af-card-muted);
}
</style>

<script>
(function () {
  var destinations = [
    {
      title: "Download the MICS Data",
      details: "Access datasets, documentation, and supporting resources.",
      href: "c01-download.html",
      category: "Guide",
      keywords: "download data datasets documentation resources mics"
    },
    {
      title: "Understanding MICS Data",
      details: "Learn about the survey design, sample, and dataset structure.",
      href: "ch-whats-in-data.html",
      category: "Guide",
      keywords: "structure sample survey microdata whats in the data mics"
    },
    {
      title: "Harmonising MICS6 reading outcomes",
      details: "Build one comparable reading dataset from many country surveys.",
      href: "c05-harmonize.html",
      category: "Guide",
      keywords: "harmonise harmonize reading fs foundational learning skills append stata r mics6"
    },
    {
      title: "R Tutorial",
      details: "Worked examples for common analytical tasks in R.",
      href: "c03-r.html",
      category: "Analysis",
      keywords: "r tidyverse regression means survey tutorial"
    },
    {
      title: "Stata Tutorial",
      details: "Worked examples for common analytical tasks in Stata.",
      href: "c04-stata.html",
      category: "Analysis",
      keywords: "stata means regression group differences tutorial"
    }
  ];

  var input = document.getElementById("af-search-input");
  var results = document.getElementById("af-search-results");
  var kbd = document.getElementById("af-search-kbd");
  var activeIndex = -1;

  if (/Mac|iPhone|iPad|iPod/.test(navigator.platform)) {
    kbd.textContent = "⌘ K";
  }

  function normalize(s) {
    return (s || "").toLowerCase();
  }

  function search(query) {
    var q = normalize(query).trim();
    if (!q) return [];
    return destinations.filter(function (d) {
      var hay = normalize(d.title + " " + d.details + " " + d.category + " " + d.keywords);
      return hay.indexOf(q) !== -1;
    });
  }

  function render(hits) {
    activeIndex = -1;
    if (!input.value.trim()) {
      results.classList.remove("open");
      input.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      results.innerHTML = "";
      return;
    }
    if (!hits.length) {
      results.innerHTML = '<div class="af-search-empty">No matching sections</div>';
      results.classList.add("open");
      input.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
      return;
    }
    results.innerHTML = hits.map(function (d, i) {
      return (
        '<a class="af-search-hit" role="option" data-index="' + i + '" href="' + d.href + '">' +
          '<div class="af-search-hit-title">' + d.title + '</div>' +
          '<div class="af-search-hit-meta">' + d.category + " · " + d.details + '</div>' +
        '</a>'
      );
    }).join("");
    results.classList.add("open");
    input.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
  }

  function setActive(next) {
    var hits = results.querySelectorAll(".af-search-hit");
    if (!hits.length) return;
    activeIndex = (next + hits.length) % hits.length;
    hits.forEach(function (el, i) {
      el.classList.toggle("active", i === activeIndex);
    });
    hits[activeIndex].scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
  }

  input.addEventListener("input", function () {
    render(search(input.value));
  });

  input.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    var hits = results.querySelectorAll(".af-search-hit");
    if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
      e.preventDefault();
      setActive(activeIndex + 1);
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
      e.preventDefault();
      setActive(activeIndex - 1);
    } else if (e.key === "Enter" && activeIndex >= 0 && hits[activeIndex]) {
      e.preventDefault();
      window.location.href = hits[activeIndex].getAttribute("href");
    } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
      results.classList.remove("open");
      input.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      input.blur();
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    var meta = e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey;
    if (meta && (e.key === "k" || e.key === "K")) {
      e.preventDefault();
      input.focus();
      input.select();
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    if (!e.target.closest(".af-search-wrap")) {
      results.classList.remove("open");
      input.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    }
  });
})();
</script>
